description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithCountryCode class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It tests the formatting of country codes into country names, verifying behavior with known inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithCountryCodeTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for FormatWithCountryCode, verifying correct formatting of country codes to country names.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and creates instance of FormatWithCountryCode.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the getFormattedValue method for different country codes, asserting correct country names or null.
